items.title: Ubisoft Creates Generative AI Game Studio Called 'Motherbrain' as Part of New Operating Model
items.excerpt: Ubisoft's Nov 19 earnings report reveals Motherbrain, a new subsidiary for 'AI for gameplay innovation' (smart NPCs with memory, AI game masters for systemic worlds); it is the team behind the voice-commanded AI-companion shooter Teammates. Follow-up to the Sept Motherbrain team reveal: now a standalone studio.

items.title: Ubisoft Says It Has A 'Very Big Pipeline Of Productions' As It Lays Off Over 150 More Developers And Starts An AI Studio
items.excerpt: Same Ubisoft story from the layoffs angle: 166 roles cut in Montreal/Quebec while the generative-AI team becomes the Motherbrain subsidiary. Alternate source for the Motherbrain card.

items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.excerpt: Google rolls out the Genie 4 world model in Project Genie to AI Ultra subscribers: edit interactive worlds in real time with natural language (weather, characters, native adaptive audio), a creative agent for building environments, and a community gallery for sharing/remixing; AI Pro waitlist. Access change after the Oct 28 Genie 4 announcement (Gemini API availability followed 11-19).

items.title: Fish with a sniper rifle takes aim at Tim Sweeney's hopes and dreams, as genAI-free meme game tops Epic Games' vibe-coding megajam
items.excerpt: Epic's AI-encouraged MegaJam popularity chart is topped by LSD: FIH, a game made without generative AI. Note: popularity ranking, check whether official winners are announced (brief: MegaJam official winners qualify once).

items.title: The Most Popular Game From Epic Games' AI MegaJam Contest Is Pure Human-Made Slop
items.excerpt: Kotaku on the same Epic AI MegaJam result: the human-made LSD: FIH leads a field full of AI-generated entries. Alternate source.

items.title: 賞金総額1000万円のAI利用推奨ゲームコンテストで「AI不使用ゲーム」が人気トップに
items.excerpt: AUTOMATON (JP) on Epic's AI-encouraged game jam (10M yen prize pool), where a game made without AI tops the popularity ranking. Alternate source for the MegaJam story.

items.title: 生成AIを活用したFMVゲーム「元カレ×デスゲーム」，2026年12月4日に基本プレイ無料で配信予定
items.excerpt: LIUGUANG STUDIO will release the free-to-play FMV game 'Ex-Boyfriend x Death Game', built with generative AI (100 ex-boyfriends gathered on a cruise ship), on Dec 4, 2026.

items.title: 슈퍼센트 "AI가 바꾼 건 사업 기회의 총량"… 에이전트 200개로 퍼블리싱 재편
items.excerpt: At Google Play's Playtime Korea 2026, mobile publisher Supercent said it rebuilt publishing around ~200 AI agents; its business lead said AI changed how many business bets the company can try, not just how fast it works. A studio deployment with specifics.

items.title: 뤼튼 이세영 대표 "크랙 IP, 전문 파트너와 게임으로 확장 가능"
items.excerpt: Wrtn (G-Star 2026 main sponsor) CEO says original IP from its AI character-chat service Crack (Kyarapu in Japan, OOC in North America) will expand into games with specialist partners. Plan, not a shipped product: weak.

items.title: Getting Started with Unreal MCP | Turn AI into Action in UE 5.8
items.excerpt: Epic publishes an official Unreal MCP course (one of a dozen videos dropped 11-19): the Epic-supported, experimental UE 5.8 bridge that lets agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) understand a project and create, modify and test in the editor, plus an in-editor Terminal plugin. Course/how-to format.

items.title: MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture Deep Dive | Inside Unreal
items.excerpt: Epic's Inside Unreal walks through the new MetaHuman Animator Markerless Motion Capture plugin (on Fab), which turns ordinary phone or webcam video into full-body MetaHuman animation, with Epic researcher Michael Black explaining the tech. Fits the 'AI animation games' keyword.

items.title: 対話型AI「Claude」が『ポケモン』関連の作業を拒否するようになったとの報告
items.excerpt: Users report that Claude now refuses Pokemon-related generation, including game imitation, assets and logos: an AI-tool guardrail that affects fan/indie game creation.

items.title: Crimson Desert Studio Pearl Abyss Now Uses AI to Validate Game Designs Before Developers Build Them
items.excerpt: Pearl Abyss details AI tools in its BlackSpace Engine that validate game designs before developers build them. Follow-up to the Pearl Abyss AI pipeline letter (published 11-14), so only use it if it adds a concrete tool.

items.title: Developer Uses Claude Code To Build A Fully Automated 3D Sports League With 30 Teams And 38 Years Of Simulated History
items.excerpt: A developer built Fock Ball, a fully automated 3D sports league (30 teams, 38 years of simulated history, AI commentary), with Claude Code. Vibe-coding category is capped per brief: low priority.

items.title: Student Game Development Competition Shut Down Because Kids Kept Submitting AI Slop
items.excerpt: A student game-dev competition was shut down after it was flooded with AI-generated submissions: an organizer's formal action on gen-AI entries.

items.title: GTA 6 Runs at 280 FPS With NVIDIA DLSS 5 on RTX 5090, but There's a Catch
items.excerpt: Demo shows GTA 6 output pushed to about 280 FPS with DLSS 5 neural rendering and frame generation on an RTX 5090. Deprioritized category (neural rendering, not a new SDK): low priority.
